summary: Warframe entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Warframe

primary.why: Warframe is an evolving live-service action game, and the PC client gives the earliest/current update route and best capture settings. Cross-platform play/save expands access, but account/platform/date state is the archive-critical detail.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current official PC client or Steam route. Record account/platform, cross-save state, build/date, story quest progress, frames/weapons owned, graphics settings, and live event state.

entries.remaster_caveats: Archive by date, build, account, cross-save state, and event/quest availability.
